   269	private theorem wrongFormEffect_ideal_norm_alice_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
   270	    (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P S)
   271	    (W : PauliKind) (δ r : ℝ)
   272	    (hstate : ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - idealState P w.aux‖ ≤ δ)
   273	    (hmass : stateQForm S.ψ
   274	        (heteroKron
   275	          (ProjectiveSetting.wrongFormEffect (.pauli W) (S.A (pauliQuestion P W))) 1) ≤ r) :
   276	    ‖applyOperatorToState
   277	        (liftedAEffect S w.φA
   278	          (ProjectiveSetting.wrongFormEffect (.pauli W) (S.A (pauliQuestion P W))))
   279	        (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * δ ^ 2 + 2 * r := by
   280	  let M : Measurement (PauliAnswer P) S.ιA := S.A (pauliQuestion P W)
   281	  let E := ProjectiveSetting.wrongFormEffect (.pauli W) M
   282	  let Q := liftedAEffect S (ιB' := w.ιB') w.φA E
   283	  let theta := isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ
   284	  let Delta := idealState P w.aux
   285	  let N := M.postprocess (validPauliAnswer (.pauli W))
   286	  have hE : E = N.effect false := by
   287	    exact wrongFormEffect_eq_validity_effect M W
   288	  have hEcontr : Eᴴ * E ≤ 1 := by
   289	    rw [hE]
   290	    exact MagicSquareRigidity.conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_effect N false
   291	  have hQcontr : Qᴴ * Q ≤ 1 := by
   292	    dsimp only [Q]
   293	    rw [raw_transfer_liftedAEffect_eq_tensor]
   294	    exact MagicSquareRigidity.conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor
   295	      (MagicSquareRigidity.conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry w.φA hEcontr)
   296	  have htheta : ‖applyOperatorToState Q theta‖ ^ 2 ≤ r := by
   297	    dsimp only [Q, theta]
   298	    rw [raw_transfer_liftedAEffect_eq_tensor,
   299	      MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry,
   300	      MagicSquareRigidity.norm_isometryTensor]
   301	    have hEpos : 0 ≤ E := by rw [hE]; exact N.pos false
   302	    have hEle : E ≤ 1 := by rw [hE]; exact measurement_effect_le_one N false
   303	    have hKpos : 0 ≤ heteroKron E (1 : Op S.ιB) :=
   304	      kronecker_nonneg hEpos (by simp)
   305	    have hKle : heteroKron E (1 : Op S.ιB) ≤ 1 := by
   306	      rw [← Matrix.one_kronecker_one]
   307	      exact kronecker_mono_left hEle (by simp)
   308	    rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq]
   309	    have hKH : (heteroKron E (1 : Op S.ιB))ᴴ = heteroKron E 1 :=
   310	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hKpos).isHermitian.eq
   311	    rw [hKH]
   312	    exact (quadratic_form_mono (MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self hKpos hKle) S.ψ).trans
   313	      hmass
   314	  have hdecomp : applyOperatorToState Q Delta =
   315	      applyOperatorToState Q (Delta - theta) + applyOperatorToState Q theta := by
   316	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   317	  rw [hdecomp]
   318	  have hfirst : ‖applyOperatorToState Q (Delta - theta)‖ ≤ δ := by
   319	    exact (MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le hQcontr _).trans (by
   320	      rw [norm_sub_rev]
   321	      exact hstate)
   322	  have htri := norm_add_le (applyOperatorToState Q (Delta - theta))
   323	    (applyOperatorToState Q theta)
   324	  have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) htri 2
   325	  have hfirstsq := pow_le_pow_left₀
   326	    (norm_nonneg (applyOperatorToState Q (Delta - theta))) hfirst 2
   327	  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖applyOperatorToState Q (Delta - theta)‖ -
   328	    ‖applyOperatorToState Q theta‖)]

   391	/-- Alice's raw prescribed-answer distance is controlled by the completed
   392	distance, state error, and malformed-answer rejection mass. -/
   393	theorem raw_pauli_operator_distanceA_le_completed {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δ : ℝ}
   394	    (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
   395	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P S)
   396	    (hstate : ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - idealState P w.aux‖ ≤ δ)
   397	    (W : PauliKind) :
   398	    rawPauliOperatorDistanceA P S w W ≤
   399	      2 * pauliOperatorDistanceA P S w W + 4 * δ ^ 2 +
   400	        4 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε := by
   401	  let M : Measurement (PauliAnswer P) S.ιA := S.A (pauliQuestion P W)
   402	  let E := ProjectiveSetting.wrongFormEffect (.pauli W) M
   403	  let bad := ‖applyOperatorToState (liftedAEffect S w.φA E)
   404	    (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2
   405	  have hmass := wrongFormPauliMass_alice_le_error S hwin W
   406	  have hbad : bad ≤ 2 * δ ^ 2 + 2 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε := by
   407	    simpa only [bad, E, M, mul_assoc] using
   408	      wrongFormEffect_ideal_norm_alice_le S w W δ _ hstate hmass
   409	  have hpoint (u : PauliRegister P) :
   410	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   411	          (liftedAEffect S w.φA (M.effect (.pauliOutcome u)) -
   412	            pauliProjOnA'' P W u) (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2 ≤
   413	        2 * ‖applyOperatorToState
   414	          (liftedAEffect S w.φA
   415	              ((M.postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect u) -
   416	            pauliProjOnA'' P W u) (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2 +
   417	          if u = 0 then 2 * bad else 0 := by
   418	    by_cases hu : u = 0
   419	    · subst u
   420	      rw [if_pos rfl, completedPauliEffect_eq_raw_add_wrongForm M W 0]
   421	      simp only [ite_true]
   422	      have hvec :
   423	          applyOperatorToState
   424	              (liftedAEffect S w.φA
   425	                  (M.effect (.pauliOutcome 0)) -
   426	                pauliProjOnA'' P W 0) (idealState P w.aux) =
   427	            applyOperatorToState
   428	                (liftedAEffect S w.φA
   429	                    (M.effect (.pauliOutcome 0) + E) -
   430	                  pauliProjOnA'' P W 0) (idealState P w.aux) -
   431	              applyOperatorToState (liftedAEffect S w.φA E)
   432	                (idealState P w.aux) := by
   433	        rw [raw_transfer_liftedAEffect_add]
   434	        simp only [applyOperatorToState, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_add,
   435	          LinearMap.add_apply]
   436	        abel
   437	      rw [hvec]
   438	      have htri := norm_sub_le
   439	        (applyOperatorToState
   440	          (liftedAEffect S w.φA
   441	              (M.effect (.pauliOutcome 0) + E) -
   442	            pauliProjOnA'' P W 0) (idealState P w.aux))
   443	        (applyOperatorToState (liftedAEffect S w.φA E) (idealState P w.aux))
   444	      have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) htri 2
   445	      dsimp only [bad]
   446	      nlinarith [sq_nonneg
   447	        (‖applyOperatorToState
   448	          (liftedAEffect S w.φA
   449	              (M.effect (.pauliOutcome 0) + E) -
   450	            pauliProjOnA'' P W 0) (idealState P w.aux)‖ -
   451	          ‖applyOperatorToState (liftedAEffect S w.φA E) (idealState P w.aux)‖)]
   452	    · rw [if_neg hu, completedPauliEffect_eq_raw_add_wrongForm M W u]
   453	      simp only [hu, ite_false, add_zero]
   454	      nlinarith [sq_nonneg
   455	        ‖applyOperatorToState
   456	          (liftedAEffect S w.φA (M.effect (.pauliOutcome u)) -
   457	            pauliProjOnA'' P W u) (idealState P w.aux)‖]
   458	  unfold rawPauliOperatorDistanceA pauliOperatorDistanceA
   459	  change (∑ u : PauliRegister P,
   460	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   461	        (liftedAEffect S w.φA (M.effect (.pauliOutcome u)) - pauliProjOnA'' P W u)
   462	        (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2) ≤
   463	    2 * (∑ u : PauliRegister P,
   464	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   465	        (liftedAEffect S w.φA ((M.postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect u) -
   466	          pauliProjOnA'' P W u) (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2) +
   467	      4 * δ ^ 2 + 4 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε
   468	  calc
   469	    (∑ u : PauliRegister P,
   470	        ‖applyOperatorToState
   471	          (liftedAEffect S w.φA (M.effect (.pauliOutcome u)) -
   472	            pauliProjOnA'' P W u) (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2) ≤

   475	            (liftedAEffect S w.φA
   476	                ((M.postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect u) -
   477	              pauliProjOnA'' P W u) (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2 +
   478	            if u = 0 then 2 * bad else 0) :=
   479	      Finset.sum_le_sum fun u _ => hpoint u

   482	            (liftedAEffect S w.φA
   483	                ((M.postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect u) -
   484	              pauliProjOnA'' P W u) (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2) + 2 * bad := by

   491	              pauliProjOnA'' P W u) (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2) +
   492	          2 * (2 * δ ^ 2 + 2 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε) := by

    16	
    17	Reviewer-facing, machine-checked evidence that the QPBT headline results rest on
    18	nothing beyond Lean's three standard axioms.  Before this module the claim was
    19	reproducible only by running a throwaway metaprogram outside the repository; a
    20	reader of the artifact could not re-derive it.
    21	
    22	Each audit below both **prints** the axiom set of a headline declaration and
    23	**fails elaboration** unless that set is exactly
    24	
    25	`{Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext}`.
    26	
    27	So the module is a compile-time regression test, not a report: if a `sorry`
    28	(`sorryAx`), a new `axiom` declaration, or any other unexpected dependency ever
    29	reaches one of these theorems, `lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.AxiomAudit`
    30	fails and CI goes red.  The printed lines remain in the build log as the
    31	positive record.
    32	
    33	This mirrors `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/AxiomAudit.lean`, which uses the same
    34	`Lean.collectAxioms` mechanism for the classical low-individual-degree track.
    35	Like that module, this one is built explicitly as a CI target rather than
    36	imported from the `MIPStarRE.QPBT` umbrella, so the audits stay out of normal
    37	downstream imports while still acting as regression tests.
    38	
    39	## What is audited
    40	
    41	The declarations are the QPBT headline results, in dependency order from the
    42	soundness statement down to the combining and extraction layers:
    43	
    44	* `pauli_soundness` — the main theorem (blueprint `thm:pauli`).
    45	* `pauli_soundness_qubit` — its qubit form (`cor:pauli-binary`).
    46	* `exists_ld_soundness` — quantum low-degree soundness (`lem:ld-soundness`).
    47	* `exists_spcc_value_one` and `honestStrategy_isSPCC` — completeness, which is
    48	  what keeps the soundness hypothesis non-vacuous.
    49	* `exists_combinedLinesWitness`, `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established`,
    50	  `exists_globalPairWitness`, `exists_actual_rounded_global_pair_error_bound` —
    51	  the combining layer.
    52	* `exists_projective_setting_isometry_bounds`,
    53	  `exists_arbitrary_strategy_isometry_bounds`,
    54	  `pauli_soundness_deltaQld_ofExtractionWitness` — the extraction layer.
    55	* `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_approx` — the symmetrization interface.
    56	
    57	`exists_extendedLinesWitness_established` and
    58	`exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_approx` are the two *corrected* forms
    59	recorded in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt-gap-register.md`; they are audited here
    60	precisely because they are the statements that were repaired against the source,
    61	so a regression in them is the one most likely to go unnoticed.
    62	-/
    63	
    64	open Lean Elab Command
    65	
    66	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.AxiomAudit
    67	
    68	/-- The axioms Lean's own core development uses, and the only ones a QPBT
    69	headline declaration may depend on. -/
    70	private def standardAxioms : Array Name :=
    71	  (#[``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound] : Array Name).qsort Name.lt
    72	
    73	private def resolveDeclIdent (id : TSyntax `ident) : CommandElabM Name := do
    74	  liftCoreM <| Lean.Elab.realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo id
    75	
    76	end MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.AxiomAudit
    77	
    78	open MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.AxiomAudit in
    79	/-- Print the axioms of a declaration and fail elaboration unless they are
    80	exactly `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`.
    81	
    82	The failure branch names `sorryAx` explicitly when it is present, because that
    83	is the diagnosis a reader wants first: an unexpected `sorryAx` means a proof
    84	was left open, while any other extra axiom means a new assumption entered the
    85	development. -/
    86	elab "audit_standard_axioms " id:ident : command => do
    87	  let declName ← resolveDeclIdent id
    88	  let axioms := (← Lean.collectAxioms declName).qsort Name.lt
    89	  logInfo m!"axioms of '{declName}': {axioms.toList}"
    90	  unless axioms == standardAxioms do
    91	    if axioms.contains ``sorryAx then
    92	      throwError
    93	        m!"'{declName}' depends on `sorryAx`: a proof it relies on is still " ++
    94	          m!"open.  Axioms: {axioms.toList}"
    95	    else
    96	      throwError
    97	        m!"'{declName}' depends on axioms {axioms.toList}, expected exactly " ++
    98	          m!"{standardAxioms.toList}"
    99	
   100	/-! ### Main theorem and its qubit form -/
   101	
   102	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauli_soundness
   103	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauli_soundness_qubit
   104	
   105	/-! ### Quantum low-degree soundness -/
   106	
   107	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_ld_soundness
   108	
   109	/-! ### Completeness
   110	
   111	Audited alongside soundness because it is what rules out the reading in which
   112	`pauli_soundness` is vacuous: `exists_spcc_value_one` produces a value-one
   113	strategy for every admissible parameter set. -/
   114	
   115	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_spcc_value_one
   116	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestStrategy_isSPCC
   117	
   118	/-! ### Combining layer -/
   119	
   120	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_combinedLinesWitness
   121	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_extendedLinesWitness_established
   122	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_globalPairWitness
   123	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_actual_rounded_global_pair_error_bound
   124	
   125	/-! ### Extraction layer -/
   126	
   127	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_projective_setting_isometry_bounds
   128	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_arbitrary_strategy_isometry_bounds
   129	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauli_soundness_deltaQld_ofExtractionWitness
   130	
   131	/-! ### Symmetrization interface -/
   132	
   133	audit_standard_axioms MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_approx

+          epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ∧

+          epsilon P.m P.d P.q) := by

+    unfold pauliBaselineExtractionConstant
+    norm_num
+  have hprojective : 1 ≤ pauliBaselineProjectiveConstant := by

+    nlinarith [sq_nonneg pauliBaselineProjectiveConstant]
+  have hb : 0 < pauliBaselineProjectivePower := by
+    unfold pauliBaselineProjectivePower pauliBaselineGlobalPairPower
+    norm_num
+  have hb1 : pauliBaselineProjectivePower < 1 := by
+    unfold pauliBaselineProjectivePower pauliBaselineGlobalPairPower
+    norm_num

+    have hcard : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card PauliEdge := Nat.cast_nonneg _
+    linarith

+  have hrawCoefficient : a ≤ rawPauliTransferFactor * (21 * a ''^ 2) := by
+    exact haa.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) hfactor)
+  have hconstant :
+      rawPauliTransferFactor *
+          (21 * (21 * pauliBaselineProjectiveConstant ''^ 2) ''^ 2) =
+        pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant := by
+    unfold rawPauliTransferFactor pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant
+    rw [pauliEdge_card]
+    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
+    ring

+    unfold pauliBaselineProjectivePower pauliBaselineGlobalPairPower

+  have hbaselineConstant : 1 ≤ pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant := by
+    have hinner : 1 ≤ 21 * a ''^ 2 := by

+    exact hb
+  have hsmall : ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon : ℝ), 0 ≤ epsilon →
+      epsilon ≤ 1 → ∀ S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P), 1 - epsilon ≤ S.value →
+        ∃ w : PauliSoundnessWitness P S,
+          ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - idealState P w.aux‖ ≤
+              deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+                epsilon P.m P.d P.q ∧
+          (∀ W : PauliKind, rawPauliOperatorDistanceA P S w W ≤
+            deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+              epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ∧
+          (∀ W : PauliKind, rawPauliOperatorDistanceB P S w W ≤
+            deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+              epsilon P.m P.d P.q) := by
+    intro P epsilon hepsilon0 hepsilon1 S hwin

+      arbitrary_strategy_isometry_bounds_explicit_baseline P epsilon hepsilon0
+        hepsilon1 S hwin
+    let d := deltaQld a pauliBaselineProjectivePower epsilon P.m P.d P.q
+    have hstate'"' :

+    have hcompletedA' : ∀ W : PauliKind,
+        pauliOperatorDistanceA P S w W ≤ d := hcompletedA
+    have hcompletedB' : ∀ W : PauliKind,
+        pauliOperatorDistanceB P S w W ≤ d := hcompletedB
+    have habsorb : 2 * d + 4 * d "'^ 2 +
+        4 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * epsilon ≤
+          deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+            epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+      dsimp only [d, a]
+      rw [← hconstant, ← hpower]
+      exact raw_pauli_error_absorb ha hb hb1 hepsilon0 hepsilon1
+    have hmono : d ≤
+        deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+          epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+      dsimp only [d, a]
+      rw [← hconstant, ← hpower]
+      exact deltaQld_mono ha hrawCoefficient le_rfl hb hepsilon0 hepsilon1
+    refine ⟨w, hstate'"'.trans hmono, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · intro W
+      calc
+        rawPauliOperatorDistanceA P S w W ≤
+            2 * pauliOperatorDistanceA P S w W + 4 * d "'^ 2 +
+              4 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * epsilon :=
+          raw_pauli_operator_distanceA_le_completed S hwin w hstate'"' W
+        _ ≤ 2 * d + 4 * d "'^ 2 + 4 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * epsilon := by
+          linarith [hcompletedA'"' W]
+        _ ≤ _ := habsorb
+    · intro W
+      calc
+        rawPauliOperatorDistanceB P S w W ≤
+            2 * pauliOperatorDistanceB P S w W + 4 * d "'^ 2 +
+              4 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * epsilon :=
+          raw_pauli_operator_distanceB_le_completed S hwin w hstate'"' W
+        _ ≤ 2 * d + 4 * d "'^ 2 + 4 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * epsilon := by
+          linarith [hcompletedB'"' W]
+        _ ≤ _ := habsorb
+  rcases le_or_gt epsilon 1 with hepsilon1 | hepsilon1
+  · exact hsmall P epsilon hepsilon0 hepsilon1 S hwin
+  · obtain ⟨w, hstate, hAraw, hBraw⟩ :=
+      hsmall P 1 zero_le_one le_rfl S (by simpa using S.value_nonneg)
+    have hmono :
+        deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+            1 P.m P.d P.q ≤
+          deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+            epsilon P.m P.d P.q :=
+      deltaQld_mono_epsilon hbaselineConstant hbaselinePower zero_le_one hepsilon1.le
+    exact ⟨w, hstate.trans hmono, fun W => (hAraw W).trans hmono,
+      fun W => (hBraw W).trans hmono⟩
+
 /-- The arbitrary-strategy soundness estimates for the raw prescribed Pauli
 answer effects of "'`thm:pauli`. The completed-family Naimark estimates remain
 internal and their transfer loss is absorbed into the existential prefactor. -/
*** End Patch

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/QubitForm.lean
@@
 theorem qubit_operator_distance_b_to_qubit
@@
   exact congrArg (fun error : ℝ => error "'^ 2) hnorm
 
+/-- Explicit current-proof baseline for the qubit form of Pauli basis test
+soundness. It uses the same fixed coefficient and power as
+`pauli_soundness_explicit_baseline`, and exact coordinate reindexing preserves
+the state norm and both raw prescribed-answer operator-family distances.
+
+This is a Lean-only quantitative specialization of blueprint
+`cor:pauli-binary` and the source statement at
+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1450-1491`.
+It introduces no hypothesis or loss beyond the issue #729 raw-effect baseline.
+-/
+theorem pauli_soundness_qubit_explicit_baseline :
+    1 ≤ pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant ∧
+    0 < pauliSoundnessBaselinePower ∧
+    pauliSoundnessBaselinePower < 1 ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon : ℝ), 0 ≤ epsilon →
+        ∀ S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P), 1 - epsilon ≤ S.value →
+          ∃ w : QubitSoundnessWitness P S,
+            ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - idealQubitState P w.aux‖ ≤
+                deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+                  epsilon P.m P.d P.q ∧
+            (∀ W : PauliKind, qubitOperatorDistanceA P S w W ≤
+              deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+                epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ∧
+            (∀ W : PauliKind, qubitOperatorDistanceB P S w W ≤
+              deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
+                epsilon P.m P.d P.q) := by
+  obtain ⟨hconstant, hpower, hpower1, hsound⟩ :=
+    pauli_soundness_explicit_baseline
+  refine ⟨hconstant, hpower, hpower1, ?_⟩
+  intro P epsilon hepsilon S hwin
+  obtain ⟨w, hstate, hA, hB⟩ := hsound P epsilon hepsilon S hwin
+  refine ⟨w.toQubit, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · exact (qubit_state_error_to_qubit P S w).trans_le hstate
+  · intro W
+    exact (qubit_operator_distance_a_to_qubit P S w W).trans_le (hA W)
+  · intro W
+    exact (qubit_operator_distance_b_to_qubit P S w W).trans_le (hB W)
+
 /-- `cor:pauli-binary`: soundness of the Pauli basis test in qubit
 coordinates. Blueprint `cor:pauli-binary`, paper
 `08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1450-1491`.
*** End Patch
PATCH

/bin/bash -lc "{
  git diff --unified=0 -- MIPStarRE | awk '/"'^'"\\+theorem / {name="'$2; sub(/[:(].*/, "", name); print name} /''^'"\\+private theorem / {name="'$3; sub(/[:(].*/, "", name); print name}'"'
  awk '/"'^theorem / {name=$2; sub(/[:(].*/, "", name); print name} /''^private theorem / {name=$3; sub(/[:(].*/, "", name); print name}'"' MIPStarRE/QPBT/ExplicitConstants.lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/ExplicitScalarBounds.lean
} | sort -u > /tmp/issue729-current-theorem-candidates.txt
: > /tmp/issue729-current-new-theorems.txt
while IFS= read -r name; do
  if "'! git grep -q -E "(private )?theorem[[:space:]]+$name([[:space:]:({]|$)" HEAD -- MIPStarRE; then
    printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$name" >> /tmp/issue729-current-new-theorems.txt
  fi
done < /tmp/issue729-current-theorem-candidates.txt
printf '"'new theorem count: '; wc -l < /tmp/issue729-current-new-theorems.txt
printf '%s\\n' 'uppercase new theorem names:'
grep '[A-Z]' /tmp/issue729-current-new-theorems.txt || true"

/-- Explicit current-proof baseline for Pauli basis test soundness. The fixed
coefficient is `346 * 21 ^ 3 * aP ^ 4`, where `aP` is the projective-setting
coefficient exposed by the issue #729 quantitative cascade, and the fixed power
is `1 / 5242880000`.

This is a Lean-only quantitative specialization of blueprint `thm:pauli` and
the paper statement at
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`.
It has exactly the source strategy and error domain and concludes the state
estimate and both raw prescribed-answer operator-family estimates for one
common normalized auxiliary state. -/
theorem pauli_soundness_explicit_baseline :
    1 ≤ pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant ∧
    0 < pauliSoundnessBaselinePower ∧
    pauliSoundnessBaselinePower < 1 ∧
      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon : ℝ), 0 ≤ epsilon →
        ∀ S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P), 1 - epsilon ≤ S.value →
          ∃ w : PauliSoundnessWitness P S,
            ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - idealState P w.aux‖ ≤
                deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
                  epsilon P.m P.d P.q ∧
            (∀ W : PauliKind, rawPauliOperatorDistanceA P S w W ≤
              deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
                epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ∧
            (∀ W : PauliKind, rawPauliOperatorDistanceB P S w W ≤
              deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
                epsilon P.m P.d P.q) := by
  obtain ⟨habsorption, -, -, -⟩ := pauli_baseline_global_absorption_bound
  have hglobal : 1 ≤ pauliBaselineGlobalPairConstant := by
    unfold pauliBaselineGlobalPairConstant
    nlinarith
  have hextraction : 1 ≤ pauliBaselineExtractionConstant := by
    unfold pauliBaselineExtractionConstant
    norm_num
  have hprojective : 1 ≤ pauliBaselineProjectiveConstant := by
    have hextractionSq : 1 ≤ pauliBaselineExtractionConstant ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hproduct : 1 ≤
        pauliBaselineExtractionConstant ^ 2 * pauliBaselineGlobalPairConstant :=
      one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hextractionSq hglobal
    unfold pauliBaselineProjectiveConstant
    nlinarith
  have hprojective4 : 1 ≤ pauliBaselineProjectiveConstant ^ 4 :=
    one_le_pow₀ hprojective
  have hcoefficient : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 346 * 21 ^ (3 : ℕ) := by norm_num
  have hconstant : 1 ≤ pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant := by
    unfold pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant
    exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hcoefficient hprojective4
  have hpower : 0 < pauliSoundnessBaselinePower := by
    unfold pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
    norm_num
  have hpower1 : pauliSoundnessBaselinePower < 1 := by
    unfold pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
    norm_num
  refine ⟨hconstant, hpower, hpower1, ?_⟩
  intro P epsilon hepsilon S hwin
  exact arbitrary_strategy_raw_isometry_bounds_explicit_baseline P epsilon hepsilon S hwin

/-- `thm:pauli`: every sufficiently successful Pauli basis test strategy admits
local isometries and an auxiliary unit state for which the state and both
operator families are close at scale `deltaQld`.  The theorem uses the
once-and-for-all self-dual-normal field model selected by `fixedFieldModel` for
    (pauliProjOnB'' P W label) (idealState P w.aux)
  rw [BinaryWitnessTransport.lifted_effect_b_reindex,
    BinaryWitnessTransport.ideal_projector_b_reindex,
    BinaryWitnessTransport.ideal_state_reindex] at hnorm
  exact congrArg (fun error : ℝ => error ^ 2) hnorm

/-- Explicit current-proof baseline for the qubit form of Pauli basis test
soundness. It uses the same fixed coefficient and power as
`pauli_soundness_explicit_baseline`, and exact coordinate reindexing preserves
the state norm and both raw prescribed-answer operator-family distances.

This is a Lean-only quantitative specialization of blueprint
`cor:pauli-binary` and the source statement at
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1450-1491`.
It introduces no hypothesis or loss beyond the issue #729 raw-effect baseline.
-/
theorem pauli_soundness_qubit_explicit_baseline :
    1 ≤ pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant ∧
    0 < pauliSoundnessBaselinePower ∧
    pauliSoundnessBaselinePower < 1 ∧
      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon : ℝ), 0 ≤ epsilon →
        ∀ S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P), 1 - epsilon ≤ S.value →
          ∃ w : QubitSoundnessWitness P S,
            ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - idealQubitState P w.aux‖ ≤
                deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
                  epsilon P.m P.d P.q ∧
            (∀ W : PauliKind, qubitOperatorDistanceA P S w W ≤
              deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
                epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ∧
            (∀ W : PauliKind, qubitOperatorDistanceB P S w W ≤
              deltaQld pauliSoundnessBaselineConstant pauliSoundnessBaselinePower
                epsilon P.m P.d P.q) := by
  obtain ⟨hconstant, hpower, hpower1, hsound⟩ :=
    pauli_soundness_explicit_baseline
  refine ⟨hconstant, hpower, hpower1, ?_⟩
  intro P epsilon hepsilon S hwin
  obtain ⟨w, hstate, hA, hB⟩ := hsound P epsilon hepsilon S hwin
  refine ⟨w.toQubit, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (qubit_state_error_to_qubit P S w).trans_le hstate
  · intro W
    exact (qubit_operator_distance_a_to_qubit P S w W).trans_le (hA W)
  · intro W
    exact (qubit_operator_distance_b_to_qubit P S w W).trans_le (hB W)

/-- `cor:pauli-binary`: soundness of the Pauli basis test in qubit
coordinates. Blueprint `cor:pauli-binary`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1450-1491`.

The theorem assumes a nonnegative error parameter, as in the source, and uses
only `P.model` and its stored basis dimension.

**Proof dependency:** The coordinate change and all three error identities are
proved, and the source theorem `pauli_soundness` is proved as well, so this
corollary is complete: its axiom closure is `propext`, `Classical.choice` and
`Quot.sound`. The composition that closed `pauli_soundness` is recorded in
issue #614, under the umbrella issue #529. -/
theorem pauli_soundness_qubit :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b < 1 ∧
      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ ε →
        ∀ S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P), 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
          ∃ w : QubitSoundnessWitness P S,
            ‖isometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - idealQubitState P w.aux‖ ≤
                deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q ∧
            (∀ W : PauliKind,
              qubitOperatorDistanceA P S w W ≤
                deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q) ∧
            ∀ W : PauliKind,
              qubitOperatorDistanceB P S w W ≤
                deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb_one, hsound⟩ := pauli_soundness
  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb_one, ?_⟩
  intro P ε hε S hS
  obtain ⟨w, hstate, hA, hB⟩ := hsound P ε hε S hS
  refine ⟨w.toQubit, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (qubit_state_error_to_qubit P S w).trans_le hstate
  · intro W
    exact (qubit_operator_distance_a_to_qubit P S w W).trans_le (hA W)
  · intro W
    exact (qubit_operator_distance_b_to_qubit P S w W).trans_le (hB W)

end

/-- Print the axioms of a declaration and fail elaboration unless they are
exactly `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`.

The failure branch names `sorryAx` explicitly when it is present, because that
is the diagnosis a reader wants first: an unexpected `sorryAx` means a proof
was left open, while any other extra axiom means a new assumption entered the
development. -/
elab "audit_standard_axioms " id:ident : command => do
  let declName ← resolveDeclIdent id
  let axioms := (← Lean.collectAxioms declName).qsort Name.lt
  logInfo m!"axioms of '{declName}': {axioms.toList}"
  unless axioms == standardAxioms do
    if axioms.contains ``sorryAx then
      throwError
        m!"'{declName}' depends on `sorryAx`: a proof it relies on is still " ++
          m!"open.  Axioms: {axioms.toList}"
    else
      throwError
        m!"'{declName}' depends on axioms {axioms.toList}, expected exactly " ++
          m!"{standardAxioms.toList}"
